scope: CPU verification on exact retained troop and commander GLBs: transferred skin weights, baked real Run/Idle deformation, shader injection, shadows, pooling, casualty counts, pause, ownership. Normal playable WebGL validation remains mandatory and is not proven by these checks.

checks.name: accepted troop topology, UVs, and source assets are preserved; weights match the retained commander surface
real retained skin gait moves legs and arms independently, not a rigid mesh bob
left and right gait banks contain different actual leg placement, not merely a rotated forward Run
marching enables pose deformation on all real units with staggered phases
sideways movement independently triggers real gait; stationarity blends into armed Idle
pause freezes every per-instance matrix and pose frame
held clashes, rewards and revival freeze gait frames, blends and stance despite elapsed render time
casualties remove real displayed slots and retain survivor animation without cosmetic respawning
shadow and lit shaders read the same real animation atlas; normals deform with the surface
baked foot surfaces never sink beneath the road and remain inside published camera bounds
3000 updates/retries retain one fixed instanced geometry, two pose textures, and bounded slots
cleanup releases only owned crowd resources and leaves original troop assets untouched
